# Checks that cannot pass while run_python is switched off (Windows by design, or RUN_PYTHON=0).

# each one was verified to PASS when run_python is on. Used only when run_python is off: with it on, nothing is skipped.

# update 24: the entry-point redirect only exists when run_python is on
entry run_python calc.py (exit 0, no output): the tool runs main.py, which imports it, and the model sees main.py's REAL error
entry the tool's run of main.py counts for the DONE gate: DONE is blocked because main.py failed
entry the bench log shows the tool's run of main.py and its output (what Casey reads in reports)
entry edit calc.py, run calc.py: the tool runs main.py, it passes, and DONE is accepted (main.py really ran clean)
entry a module that nothing imports keeps the old 'it printed nothing' message (no redirect)
entry the next-step hint follows main.py's result (failed), not calc.py's (printed nothing)
entry two files import the module: the tool names both and runs neither
entry a module that PRINTS something is not redirected, even though another file imports it
entry a helper that failed when run alone is cleared by a clean run of the file that imports it
# update 25: the expected-output gate is part of the DONE gate, which needs run_python
